name: 197. Anthropic mid-conversation tool changes keep their tool object on every inbound route (#8207)
description: Mid-conversation tool changes (beta mid-conversation-tool-changes-2026-07-01; by-value definitions under inline-tools-2026-09-15) add or withdraw tools from a role:system message inside messages[] without touching tools[], so the prompt-cache prefix stays intact. Issue #8207: the tool object on tool_addition / tool_removal blocks was dropped in the Responses conversion, the request still returned 200, and the model never saw the added tool. Covers both routes that reach the Anthropic provider with these blocks: the Anthropic SDK surface (/anthropic/v1/messages, beta header supplied by the client) and the neutral OpenAI-shaped surface (/v1/responses, where the client cannot set anthropic-beta and the gateway must derive both betas from the body). Cases pin the raw request via x-bf-send-back-raw-request and the model behaviour (it calls a tool it was given mid-conversation; it does not call one that was withdrawn). Bedrock, Bedrock Mantle and Vertex are not covered here: their egress inlines mid-conversation system messages as text, which cannot carry a tool.

item.name: anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5 /anthropic/v1/messages inline tool_addition definition reaches the provider - mid-conversation tool changes - #8207

exec: var txt = pm.response.text() || '';
var body = {};
try { body = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { body = {}; }
var rr = (body.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
var wire = JSON.stringify(rr || null);
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 tool_addition: request accepted (200)', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'want 200; a 400 means the block reached Anthropic malformed or the inline-tools beta was stripped, any other status is a real failure: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 tool_addition: the system message with the tool_addition block reaches the provider', function () {
if (pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-request-type') === 'passthrough') {
// Native Messages passthrough forwards the caller's body as sent and returns Anthropic's own
// bytes, so there is no raw_request; anthropicmsg and the route tests cover those bytes offline.
pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('x-bifrost-provider'), 'native passthrough answered by another provider: ' + pm.response.text().slice(0, 300)).to.eql('anthropic');
return;
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable - x-bf-send-back-raw-request not honored: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
var tools = Array.isArray(rr.tools) ? rr.tools : [];
pm.expect(tools.length, 'tools[] must still hold only echo (the added tool must not be hoisted into tools): ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(tools[0] && tools[0].name, 'tools[0] must be echo: ' + wire.slice(0, 600)).to.eql('echo');
var msgs = Array.isArray(rr.messages) ? rr.messages : [];
var sys = msgs.filter(function (m) { return m && m.role === 'system'; });
pm.expect(sys.length, 'the role:system message carrying tool_addition was dropped before the provider (pre-fix: no case for the block type): ' + wire.slice(0, 800)).to.eql(1);
var blocks = Array.isArray(sys[0].content) ? sys[0].content : [];
pm.expect(blocks.length, 'system content must hold exactly the tool_addition block: ' + JSON.stringify(sys[0])).to.eql(1);
pm.expect(blocks[0].type, 'block type: ' + JSON.stringify(blocks[0])).to.eql('tool_addition');
var tool = blocks[0].tool || {};
pm.expect(tool.type, 'tool object dropped (pre-fix: AnthropicContentBlock had no tool field): ' + JSON.stringify(blocks[0])).to.eql('tool_definition');
var def = tool.definition || {};
pm.expect(def.name, 'definition.name: ' + JSON.stringify(tool)).to.eql('get_weather');
pm.expect(def.description, 'definition.description must round-trip: ' + JSON.stringify(tool)).to.eql('Get the current weather for a city.');
var props = (def.input_schema || {}).properties || {};
pm.expect(props.city, 'definition.input_schema.properties.city must round-trip: ' + JSON.stringify(tool)).to.be.an('object');
pm.test('anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 tool_addition: the response completes normally', function () {
// tool_choice any/tool returns 400 on Sonnet 5.5, so whether the model calls get_weather cannot be forced and is not the pass condition;
// the raw_request assertions above are the deterministic proof that the added tool reached the model.
pm.expect(body.type, 'response type: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.eql('message');
pm.expect(['end_turn', 'tool_use'], 'stop_reason: ' + txt.slice(0, 300)).to.include(body.stop_reason);
var content = Array.isArray(body.content) ? body.content : [];
var bad = content.filter(function (b) { return b && b.type === 'tool_use' && b.name !== 'get_weather' && b.name !== 'echo'; });
pm.expect(bad.length, 'tool_use for a tool that was never offered: ' + JSON.stringify(content).slice(0, 600)).to.eql(0);
